description: Agents return outcome success/done/approved/pass where the PhaseResult contract allows only complete|skipped|failed, forcing a full extra dispatch per occurrence (measured on host B and host C in COMP-HOST-PORTABILITY-1; 23 occurrences across stratum+compose via learn harvest). Decide: fix the step instructions/schema vocabulary, or normalize equivalent completion words before the costly retry. Check the steps first; do not loosen the contract blind. Gap G6.
